import ctypes
const_mul=0xf4243
const_e=0xeeeeeeeeeeeeeeef
const_add=0x2222222222222222
const_cmp=0x1111111111111110

def cond(n):
    rdx=(n*const_mul) & 0xffffffffffffffff
    rdx=(rdx+7) & 0xffffffffffffffff
    rdx=(rdx*rdx) & 0xffffffffffffffff
    rdx=(rdx+0xe) & 0xffffffffffffffff
    rdx=(rdx*const_e) & 0xffffffffffffffff
    rdx=(rdx+const_add) & 0xffffffffffffffff
    return const_cmp >= rdx, rdx

for n in range(0,65):
